The sweater, trousers, coat and boots are all in fabrics that suit hard cold, and their level fits an office day. The scarf and beret cover your neck and head on the way, and the scarf is the piece that sits next to your face. I chose the suede boots on purpose: they suit the frost and the office, and if the roads are salted they only need a little care when you arrive.\",\"how_to_wear\":[\"Wrap the scarf around your neck and tuck its ends inside the coat, so the wind has no way in at the collar.\",\"Pull the beret down snugly so it covers your ears for the whole walk.\",\"If the roads are salted, wipe the suede boots with a slightly damp cloth when you get to work and let them dry away from a radiator.\"],\"wrong_photos\":[],\"named\":[{\"n\":\"#102·24\",\"what\":\"scarf\"},{\"n\":\"#38·29\",\"what\":\"coat\"},{\"n\":\"#122·13\",\"what\":\"beret\"},{\"n\":\"#54·07\",\"what\":\"suede ankle boots\"},{\"n\":\"#110·28\",\"what\":\"sweater\"},{\"n\":\"#30·31\",\"what\":\"trousers\"}],\"about_items\":[{\"n\":\"#110·28\",\"text\":\"The sweater is at the right level for an office day, and its knit is warm enough for deep frost.\"},{\"n\":\"#30·31\",\"text\":\"The trousers fit an office day, and their fabric is warm enough for deep frost.\"},{\"n\":\"#38·29\",\"text\":\"The coat is wool, which ranks it above other outer layers in the cold. Its level fits your workday and its fabric suits deep frost.\"},{\"n\":\"#54·07\",\"text\":\"I chose these boots on purpose: their level fits an office day and the fabric suits deep frost. Suede needs care only if the roads are salted.\"},{\"n\":\"#102·24\",\"text\":\"The scarf is here for the frost: its fabric suits deep cold, and it is the piece that sits next to your face on the walk.\"},{\"n\":\"#122·13\",\"text\":\"The beret is here because its fabric suits deep frost and it keeps your head covered on the walk.\"}]}"}],"usage":{"input_tokens":26324,"output_tokens":1996},"stop_reason":"end_turn"}
